name: AuteurFrame
notes: Agent swarm: research, screenplay, art direction, parallel animators, vision critic, sound design and mastering.
Timeline editor with scene, caption, layer and audio tracks plus agent actions on right-click.
Template feed: new templates published to this repository appear in every studio under Templates.

templates.name: Launch Announcement
templates.description: Announce a product or feature: bold headline, three pillars, how it works in steps, a customer quote and a call to action.

templates.name: Version Release
templates.description: Release notes as a film: a glowing version badge, the headline, what is new as an icon grid, and where to get it.
